articles.text: 学生: もしもし、(教師の名字)さんのお宅ですか。 (Gakusei: Moshi moshi, (instructor's name)-san no otaku desu ka?)
STUDENT: Hello. Is this Mr./Mrs. (instructor's name)'s residence?
教師: はい、そうです。 (Kyoushi: Hai, soo desu.)
学生: (学生の勤め先)の(学生の名字)ですが、ご主人/奥さんいらっしゃいますか。 (Gakusei: (student's work place) no (student's family name) desu ga, goshujin/okusan irasshaimasu ka?)
STUDENT: I'm (student's family name) from (student's work place). Is your husband/wife in?
教師: 少々お待ち下さい。 (Kyoushi: Shooshoo omachi kudasai.)
INSTRUCTOR: Please hold on a moment. (Then the roles are reversed and the practice continues in similar fashion.)
